# Vault fixtures

Synthetic vaults for vault-level tests (D-50).

| Fixture | Used by | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `new-empty/` | FR-VLT-02 AC-1, AC-3: the exact files a new empty vault gets (D-89, D-90, D-99) | **Approved by the owner 2026-10-11 (D-99).** Derived from BRD §5.1, FR-TYP-01/-03/-08/-12, FR-TSK-01…03 (D-25, D-70), FR-TAG-01/-05, FR-ATT-07, FR-FMT-09, FR-VLT-05. Not from the BRD, approved with it: icons (names from a common icon set), colors, preview attributes, the `review: locked` value, attribute names, Image/PDF metadata keys (`media-type`, `size`, `width`, `height`, `pages`), and the YAML layout |

Byte-exact: LF, UTF-8 without BOM, NFC. Universal attributes (FR-TYP-08: description, aliases, tags, source, icon, cover, review) are built in and not listed per type.

| Fixture | Used by | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `search/` | MS2 search and switcher ACs in `docs/acceptance/search-navigation.md` (FR-SRC-01…04, FR-NAV-01). Hand-written; the test copies `new-empty/.tegg/` next to it to make it a vault. Contents: five objects that contain the word `rozpočet` (one untyped file without frontmatter), a phrase pair (`rozpočet projektu` adjacent vs. separated), a task with `priority: High`, an unreviewed Quick Note created `2026-10-06T00:30:00+02:00` (22:30 UTC the day before, for date-filter edges), an alias `Reading list`, a match on line 24 for snippet location, plus a template and a trashed note that contain the same words and must never appear in results | Draft for MS2, pending owner review with AP-46…AP-54 (`docs/acceptance/README.md`) |

Copy it out of the repo before opening it in Obsidian (Obsidian writes `.obsidian/`) |
